author: HBO Max
description:
Enter the world of DC Super-Villains as James Gunn puts his own movie on trial in The Suicide Squad: Is It Canon? The Official Podcast, joined by Jennifer Holland and Steve Agee for a special one-off episode presented by DC Studios.

The conversation turns to one of DC's most unpredictable teams and the characters who make them so memorable. Gunn, Holland, and Agee tackle the canon question, with fan questions from the DC Discord, a studio full of Task Force X props, and video messages from John Cena and David Dastmalchian. The result is a funny, fan-driven look at the movie and its place in the DCU.

Here's what's on the table:

✅ The DC universe, explained: Need a refresher on the DCEU, the DCU, and Elseworlds? The panel lays out the differences and explains why the canon question is worth asking.

✅ Your questions, their answers: DC Discord fans bring up Captain Boomerang, Rick Flag, Amanda Waller, Weasel, Mongal, The Detachable Kid, Flo Crawley, Bloodsport, Harley Quinn, and more.
title: The Suicide Squad: Is It Canon? The Official Podcast | HBO Max

author: HBO Max
description:
The Suicide Squad: Is It Canon? The Official Podcast is coming October 30. Enter the world of DC Super-Villains as writer/director and co-head of DC Studios James Gunn teams up with Jennifer Holland (Emilia Harcourt) and Steve Agee (John Economos, and technically King Shark) for a special one-off episode to answer the question fans keep asking: what is canon?

The Suicide Squad came out before the cinematic DCU existed. Since then, Peacemaker has gotten his own show, and Weasel has joined the Creature Commandos. The trio digs into Harley, Bloodsport, Ratcatcher 2, King Shark, Amanda Waller, and more, with stories from the set, messages from a few friends from The Suicide Squad, and answers to your fan questions.

Whether you’ve watched The Suicide Squad a dozen times or you’re just discovering the movie that kicked off James Gunn’s DC journey, this special is your guide to what counts in the DCU. Stream The Suicide Squad on HBO Max before you tune in.
